scope: Finance Core physical foundation and accounting contracts. No API, UI, reports, consolidation engine, DOAF, transfer/payable workflows or Payroll (F1B/F1C/F1D/F2).
authorization: Not in F1A domain calls. The F1B application layer must authorize with TerritorialAuthority(data_type=FINANCE) and the D31 permissions BEFORE calling these services (permission before target resolution, F-06).

money.float: forbidden (TypeError / no FLOAT or DOUBLE column)

entry_lifecycle.subledger_entries: born POSTED inside the subledger transaction

J01.name: balanced posting
J01.rule: DRAFT->SUBMITTED->POSTED once; idempotent replay returns the same entry; different payload = IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; audit on the owner unit

J02.name: unbalanced posting denied
J02.rule: UNBALANCED / TOO_FEW_LINES / AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE; a failed subledger posting leaves no header, line or claim; CHECK ck_journal_lines_one_side

J03.name: posted immutable
J03.rule: every service path refuses a POSTED entry; header and lines byte-identical; only DRAFT lines are replaceable

J04.name: reversal contract
J04.rule: exact inverse, reason, OPEN period of the same unit, UNIQUE reversal_of_id, no reversal of a reversal, SUBLEDGER_OWNED

J05.name: accrual revenue
J05.rule: RECEIVABLE_RECOGNITION Dr RECEIVABLES / Cr INCOME (result, no cash) then SETTLEMENT Dr CASH / Cr RECEIVABLES (cash, no result)

J06.name: accrual expense
J06.rule: PAYABLE_RECOGNITION Dr EXPENSE / Cr PAYABLES then SETTLEMENT Dr PAYABLES / Cr CASH

J07.name: cash/bank balance derived
J07.rule: no balance column; balance = SUM POSTED lines; drafts never count; financial account posts to its own control account

J08.name: fixed-asset investment
J08.rule: Dr FIXED_ASSETS / Cr CASH|PAYABLES, immediate result 0; rubric mapping configurable, posted lines unchanged

J10.name: SEND no P&L
J10.rule: Dr INTERUNIT_CLEARING_OUT (counterparty, purpose) / Cr CASH|BANK of the origin only; TRANSFER_TOUCHES_RESULT; INTERUNIT_ONLY_BY_TRANSFER

J11.name: RECEIVE no P&L
J11.rule: Dr CASH|BANK / Cr INTERUNIT_CLEARING_IN of the destination only; one RECEIVE per transfer (UNIQUE)

J12.name: in-transit state
J12.rule: SEND without RECEIVE is consistent (CHECK), shows as in transit, no result; D-04A.3 example: perimeter revenue 100 000, never 160 000 / 200 000

J13.name: owner unit
J13.rule: owner unit NOT NULL + indexed; line unit = entry unit and account owned by the line unit (composite FKs); no department owner

J14.name: closed-period posting denied
J14.rule: unit close refuses postings/drafts of that unit only; reopen segregated; national close lists open units and is irreversible

J15.name: money precision
J15.rule: > 2 decimals rejected, float TypeError, CHECK ck_journal_lines_scale / limit, exact 0.10 + 0.20

J16.name: AOA-only
J16.rule: only AOA installed; any other entry or account currency CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED

C1.rule: two processes post the same entry: one OK, one ALREADY_POSTED; same idempotency key: one entry

C3A.rule: deterministic: CLOSE holds the period lock, POST observed in LOCK WAIT on accounting_periods; CLOSE OK, POST PERIOD_CLOSED, 0 header/line/claim, unit CLOSED, later posting refused

C3B.rule: deterministic: POST holds the period share lock, CLOSE observed in LOCK WAIT on accounting_periods; POST OK then CLOSE OK; entry POSTED before closed_at, balanced, later posting refused

mutation_probes.M2: allow mutation of a POSTED entry's lines
mutation_probes.M5: INTERUNIT_CONTROL clearing accounts installed as INCOME (revenue)
mutation_probes.M8: FIXED_ASSETS rubrics always mapped to expense
mutation_probes.M9: posting allowed in a closed unit period
mutation_probes.M10: financial balance stored as a column (source of truth)
mutation_probes.M12: second APPROVED budget allowed (approved guard removed)

f1b_contracts.scope: Interunit transfers (request/send/receive/cancel/reverse-send/reconcile), fund custody read model, subtree perimeter base, contributions (external origin), Territorial authority FINANCE, API + UI. Not F1B: bank statements/reconciliation (F1C), budget workflow, consolidated DRE, full DOAF (F1D), Payroll/HR (F2).
f1b_contracts.decision_F1B_D1: Interunit reconciliation is an explicit FINANCE_RECONCILE step after RECEIVE (refines ADR 0021 D10 / D-04A.5 which made it automatic): migration 2026_09_30_100024 only relaxes ck_internal_transfers_received and adds ck_internal_transfers_reconciled; no state, table or column is added.

transitions.send: DRAFT -> SENT (origin, FINANCE_TRANSFER+FINANCE_POST, TRANSFER_SEND Dr INTERUNIT_CLEARING_OUT / Cr CASH|BANK)
transitions.receive: SENT -> RECEIVED (destination, FINANCE_TRANSFER+FINANCE_POST, TRANSFER_RECEIVE Dr CASH|BANK / Cr INTERUNIT_CLEARING_IN, amount = SEND amount)
transitions.reverse_send: SENT -> CANCELLED (origin, REVERSE_SEND, only before RECEIVE)
transitions.reconcile: RECEIVED: reconciled_at once (origin or destination, FINANCE_RECONCILE, SEND <-> transfer <-> RECEIVE verified)

f1b_contracts.custody_identity: opening + external received + internal received - external applications - internal sent (net of REVERSE_SEND) = closing (CASH/BANK POSTED lines of the unit)

mutation_probes.M3: SEND clearing as EQUITY instead of INTERUNIT_CONTROL
mutation_probes.M12: transfer mutates the original external revenue

receivables.note: partial settlement is derived from settlement_allocations (never stored); RECOGNIZED/SETTLED require recognition_entry_id (CHECK)

payables.note: same as receivables; document + workflow instance mandatory (catalog NOT NULL); an approval step, if the institution wants one, lives in the workflow instance, not in a new state

settlements.note: a settlement is born POSTED with its entry (D07); cancellation = the subledger reversal flow; no migration needed

f1c_contracts.scope: Accrual subledgers (receivables, payables, settlements, cancellation), financial accounts lifecycle, bank statements, bank reconciliation, budget workflow, accounting period close / reopen / national close, actual vs budget foundation, Territorial authority FINANCE, API + UI. Not F1C: consolidated DRE, DOAF, final reports / exports / dashboards (F1D), Payroll / HR (F2).

v1_transitions.recognize: -> RECOGNIZED (RECEIVABLE_RECOGNITION Dr RECEIVABLES / Cr revenue rubric, no cash)
v1_transitions.cancel: RECOGNIZED (no POSTED settlement) -> CANCELLED (REVERSAL of the recognition)

receivables.pending: reserved: D07 subledger entries are born POSTED and the subledger row has no rubric column, so V1 recognises in the creating transaction

v1_transitions.recognize: -> RECOGNIZED (PAYABLE_RECOGNITION Dr rubric control account EXPENSE | FIXED_ASSETS / Cr PAYABLES, no cash; document mandatory)

v1_transitions.settle: -> POSTED (SETTLEMENT Dr CASH|BANK / Cr RECEIVABLES or Dr PAYABLES / Cr CASH|BANK)
v1_transitions.cancel: POSTED -> CANCELLED (own-flow REVERSAL of the settlement entry, reason, open period)

subledger_states.outstanding: amount - SUM(allocations of POSTED settlements), derived, decided on a locking read with the receivable / payable row FOR UPDATE

accrual.revenue_recognised_once: at recognition; a settlement never touches INCOME / EXPENSE (SETTLEMENT shape has none)
accrual.non_receivable_basis: ADR 0021 D01.2 (tithes, offerings and donations recognised when received; in kind has its own D04 flow)
accrual.capitalised_acquisition: payable debit = the rubric control account (FIXED_ASSETS for INV_AST_*), D-04A.12

f1c_contracts.own_flow_reversal: LedgerPostingService::postSubledgerReversal: REVERSAL entry (journal CHECK) whose target kind is SETTLEMENT | PAYABLE_RECOGNITION | RECEIVABLE_RECOGNITION; the generic reverse() still refuses subledger entries (SUBLEDGER_OWNED)

financial_accounts.open: FINANCE_ACCOUNT_MANAGE (+ FINANCE_POST with an opening balance); CASH -> cash_registers with a People-visible custodian; BANK -> bank_account_details with the number encrypted (Files key ring, ADR 0019 D06), last 4 shown
financial_accounts.opening_balance: OPENING_BALANCE entry Dr CASH|BANK / Cr OPENING_NET_ASSETS (D06), never a column
financial_accounts.canonical_balance: SUM(debit) - SUM(credit) of POSTED journal lines (LedgerQueries)
financial_accounts.close: D06: canonical balance zero + no DRAFT / SUBMITTED entry on the account (locking reads, account FOR UPDATE); no reopen
financial_accounts.closed_account: refuses every posting (FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_CLOSED decided on a locking read); history and balance stay readable

non_negative_cash_bank.rule: CASH and BANK never negative in V1: every posting that reduces a financial account checks, with the account FOR UPDATE and a locking read of the canonical balance, current_posted_balance - outgoing_amount >= 0, else INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS (payments, settlements, SEND, reversals, account transfers, any other posting)
non_negative_cash_bank.accrual: receivables / payables are recognised without available funds; only the payment needs funds
non_negative_cash_bank.overdraft: out of V1; a future facility needs an explicit representation, never a negative balance
non_negative_cash_bank.enforced_in: LedgerPostingService::assertNoOverdraft (the posting gate, every entry kind)

bank_statements.ingestion: manual / structured V1, header + all lines in one transaction, never edited
bank_statements.document: Files document of type BANK_STATEMENT owned by the account unit (public id only), file_id = its latest version; source_hash = the file content SHA-256, UNIQUE per account
bank_statements.coherence: opening + SUM(lines) = closing; every line inside the statement range; amount_signed <> 0

bank_reconciliation.versions: one OPEN version per (account, MONTH period); version = previous + 1
bank_reconciliation.invariants: same unit and BANK account, journal entry POSTED and dated up to the period end, money in <-> debit / money out <-> credit, SUM(matched) <= |statement line| and <= journal line across EVERY reconciliation

post_close_policy.rule: a closed period (unit or irreversible national close) does not block reconciliation of existing facts: open / match / unmatch / close a reconciliation, never write, change or back-date the ledger
post_close_policy.adjustment: POST reconciliations/{r}/adjustments posts the unmatched remainder of a statement line (EXPENSE out / REVENUE in) in the first OPEN period >= the line date, document = the bank statement, description + audit reference the statement, line and reconciliation; once per statement line (ALREADY_ADJUSTED)

bank_reconciliation.lock_order: reconciliation FOR UPDATE -> statement line FOR UPDATE -> journal line FOR UPDATE (adjust: period of the posting date FOR SHARE first, then the ledger locks)

budget.one_approved: approved_guard + UNIQUE; every version of (unit, year, fund) locked FOR UPDATE in id order before deciding; older than the approved one -> BUDGET_VERSION_OUTDATED; newer supersedes in the same transaction
budget.revision: new DRAFT version copied from the APPROVED one; nothing overwritten
budget.actual_vs_budget: POSTED journal lines of unit / fund / rubric, YTD from 1 January; variance = actual - budget; variance % NULL when budget = 0
budget.not_in_f1c: APPROVED -> CLOSED at year end; monthly phasing (D13 deferred)

periods.unit_close: FINANCE_PERIOD_CLOSE on the unit; no DRAFT / SUBMITTED entries of the unit in the month
periods.reopen: FINANCE_PERIOD_REOPEN, reason, reopener != closer, only while the month is nationally OPEN; the close row keeps closed_at / closed_by
periods.national_close: FINANCE_PERIOD_CLOSE through a scope covering the national root (single ACTIVE GENERAL_DIRECTION without parent); every unit with POSTED lines closed; irreversible (no reopen exists)

mutation_probes.M6: posting into a closed financial account
mutation_probes.M7: bank line treated as journal automatically

product_findings.F1C-P01: posting gate decided a financial account OPEN status on a snapshot read (a posting waiting for an account close could commit into the closed account): now a locking read in LedgerPostingService::lockOpenAccounts; fixed before commit
product_findings.F1C-P02: national close decided "units with lines not closed" on a snapshot read after the period lock wait (could close a month over an unclosed unit): locking reads in FinancePeriods; reproduced by PC2 without the fix; fixed before commit

additional_mutation_probes.M18: FIN-D11 closed period blocks reconciliation again
additional_mutation_probes.M19: FIN-D11 adjustment back-dated into the closed month

decisions.F1C-D1: PENDING reserved: V1 creates RECOGNIZED directly in the accounting operation (the subledger rows keep no rubric before recognition; no artificial draft)
decisions.FIN-D11: reconciliation of closed periods allowed without touching the ledger (decided 2026-10-01, ADR 0021)

f1d_contracts.scope: Finance Core V1 reporting and consolidation; Payroll remains absent.

views.own_economic: DRE from POSTED INCOME/EXPENSE journal lines on accrual basis
views.own_custody: DOAF from POSTED CASH/BANK lines, with internal received/sent shown explicitly
views.consolidated_subtree: historical perimeter at report end; internal custody movements eliminated, boundary movements retained

f1d_contracts.historical_perimeter: ReportPerimeterResolver over unit_parent_periods at report_end_date; organizational_units.parent_id is used only to validate current consolidated grant coverage
f1d_contracts.snapshot: one REPEATABLE READ transaction for authorization, historical perimeter and every report query (ADR 0021 C8)

authority.consolidated: FINANCE_REPORT + FINANCE_CONSOLIDATED_VIEW on root with current subtree coverage
authority.concealment: unknown and out-of-scope unit both 404 after permission precheck

f1d_contracts.exports: CSV uses the exact report read model and filters; audited as finance.export; official header fields are included
